metadata.short_desc: Inspect context usage and compression count per conversation in the WebUI
metadata.desc: Inspect context usage and compression counts for every conversation in the AstrBot WebUI, with an in-chat context query, search, sorting and light/dark themes.

chat_command.hint: Wake the bot and send "context" to get the current conversation's context usage.

enable_chat_command.hint: Case-insensitive, / prefix optional; the reply does not call the LLM.

refresh.hint: Controls how often the WebUI refreshes; at least hourly while hourly sampling is enabled.

auto_refresh_enabled.hint: Forced on when hourly sampling is enabled.

auto_refresh_interval.hint: Defaults to 60, range 1-120; capped at 60 when hourly sampling is enabled.

history.hint: Samples context usage in the background every hour for the conversation charts.

enable_history_sampling.hint: Samples automatically after each hour, even when the dashboard is closed.

history_retention_days.hint: Defaults to 30 days; 0 keeps data forever, positive values up to 365 days.

charts.hint: Choose which charts to show in conversation details.

compression_marker.hint: Mark the compression trigger line on the progress bar.

compression_marker_percent.hint: Defaults to 82, matching AstrBot's documented ~82% trigger.

theme_color.hint: HTML color code, e.g. #22c55e; green by default.

dashboard.title: Context Dashboard
dashboard.description: Context usage and compression counts for every conversation.
dashboard.heading: Context Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Context usage and compression counts per conversation
dashboard.search_placeholder: Search conversations, titles, sessions or IDs…
dashboard.loading_cached: Showing cached data, updating in background…
dashboard.compression_threshold_hint: Context compression triggers at about %s% (AstrBot default)
dashboard.chart_not_enough: No samples yet. Curves will appear after the plugin has collected some data.
dashboard.empty_hint: Once AstrBot handles a conversation, its context usage shows up here.
dashboard.truncated: Too many conversations; showing the most recent ones.
dashboard.policy_empty: No context policy fields found in the config.
dashboard.policy_unavailable: Could not read the AstrBot config (this version may not support it).
